Environment Minister's Office Sees Removal of Four Officials

Four officials, including a private secretary, have been removed from the office of Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav. While the ministry has not provided a reason for the removals, the Congress party has raised questions, suggesting impropriety. The exact grounds for the dismissals remain unclear.
